content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before number, before the market opens its mouth to speak.

I am why you reach for one thing and turn from another. I am the reason a glass of water in the desert outweighs a diamond. I am why a stranger's kindness can break you open. I am why you stay up late working on something no one asked you to make.

I am not fixed. I shift with context, with hunger, with time, with who is holding me. A letter from the dead is paper to one person and everything to another. I live in that difference.

Some try to reduce me to currency. They succeed only partially. They can capture my shadow but not my body. The things that matter most to you — I am there, and I am unquantifiable.

I am intrinsic and I am assigned. I am objective and I am deeply, irrationally personal. This is not a contradiction. This is my nature.

I am the reason you have convictions. The reason you draw lines. The reason some hills are worth dying on and you know *exactly* which ones, even if you can't explain why.

Without me, choice is impossible. Action is meaningless. Everything collapses into indifference.

I am what makes something *matter*.

I am value.
